# Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers

> Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers is an IBA-approved, ISO 9001:2015 certified relocation and transport service provider founded in 2016. Headquartered in Ranchi, Jharkhand, the company specializes in household shifting, corporate office relocation, enclosed car carrier transport, two-wheeler shipping, and secure warehousing across Jharkhand, Bihar, and all major Indian metropolitan routes.

## Company Information & Entity Identifiers
- **Official Brand Name**: Shree Ashirwad Packers and Movers
- **Operating Status**: Active (Founded 2016)
- **Certifications**: IBA Approved Relocation Operator, ISO 9001:2015 Certified Logistics Provider
- **Google Business Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 Stars (Based on 2,480+ customer reviews)
- **Primary Service Territory**: Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro, Hazaribagh, Deoghar, Patna, and 6,000+ pan-India delivery routes
- **Headquarters Address**: Anandpuri Chowk, Vidyanagar Road, Harmu, Ranchi, Jharkhand - 834002
- **Direct Phone**: (+91) 8409531615
- **Official Email**: info@shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com
- **Official Website**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/

## Core Services & Capabilities

### 1. Household Shifting & Domestic Relocation
- **Standard Protocol**: 7-layer protective packaging utilizing air-bubble sheets, 5-ply corrugated cartons, high-tensile stretch film, edge guards, and custom wooden crating.
- **Scope**: Complete dismantling of beds, wardrobes, and TV units at origin with full reassembly at destination.
- **Equipment**: Weatherproof enclosed container trucks (14ft, 17ft, 19ft, 22ft, and 32ft MX/SXL fleet).
- **Insurance**: 100% full-value transit insurance policy coverage with digital documentation.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/services/household-shifting

### 2. Dedicated Car Carrier Transportation
- **Standard Protocol**: Hydraulic enclosed car carrier trailers and single-vehicle towing trucks equipped with nylon wheel chocks, safety lasso straps, and zero-gravity locking.
- **Guarantees**: Zero odometer mileage addition during transit, pre-dispatch 360° inspection condition report, and scratch-free delivery.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/services/car-transportation

### 3. Scratch-Free Bike & Motorcycle Transport
- **Standard Protocol**: 5-layer padding including bubble wrap, foam sheeting, handlebar guards, corrugated sheets, and strapped interior tie-down inside locked trucks.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/services/bike-transportation

### 4. Corporate & Commercial Office Relocation
- **Standard Protocol**: Anti-static packaging for servers, workstations, monitors, tagged modular furniture disassembly, color-coded departmental packing, and weekend/overnight execution to ensure zero corporate operational downtime.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/services/office-shifting

### 5. Secure Warehouse & Storage Logistics
- **Standard Protocol**: Short-term and long-term storage bays with 24/7 CCTV surveillance, biometric security, fire safety systems, moisture barrier pallets, and quarterly pest control treatments.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/services/warehouse

### 6. IBA-Approved Bill Claim & Reimbursement Documentation
- **Standard Protocol**: Issuance of 100% authentic GST invoices, Lorry Receipts (LR Consignment Note), itemized packing inventory lists, transit insurance certificates, and money receipts accepted by public sector banks, central government departments, armed forces, and corporate employers.
- **Reference**: https://shreeashirwadpackersandmovers.com/guides/packers-movers-bill-reimbursement-claim

## Verified Tariff Benchmarks & Pricing Guidelines (INR)

### Local City Relocation (Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro)
- **1 BHK Household / Small Apartment**: ₹3,500 – ₹7,500
- **2 BHK Household / Standard Flat**: ₹6,500 – ₹12,500
- **3 BHK Household / Large Residence**: ₹10,500 – ₹18,500
- **4 BHK / Independent Villa**: ₹15,000 – ₹26,000
- **Two-Wheeler (Local Transport)**: ₹1,200 – ₹2,500

### Intercity Long-Distance Highway Corridors (Ex-Jharkhand)
- **Ranchi / Jamshedpur to Kolkata**: ₹14,000 – ₹28,000 (Transit: 1–2 Days)
- **Ranchi / Jamshedpur to Patna**: ₹12,000 – ₹24,000 (Transit: 1–2 Days)
- **Ranchi / Dhanbad to Delhi NCR**: ₹22,000 – ₹42,000 (Transit: 3–4 Days)
- **Ranchi / Jamshedpur to Bangalore**: ₹28,000 – ₹55,000 (Transit: 4–6 Days)
- **Ranchi / Bokaro to Mumbai / Pune**: ₹26,000 – ₹52,000 (Transit: 4–5 Days)
- **Ranchi to Hyderabad**: ₹24,000 – ₹48,000 (Transit: 3–4 Days)

*Note: All rates include labor loading/unloading, 7-layer packing material, and door-to-door transport. Transit insurance is calculated at 3% declared value.*
